notes.title: Price Changes and Upcoming Release
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone!

Over night (German time), there was a little store hiccup and we apologize. It showed that the game would cost $5.99 which was incorrect and is now corrected. Steam support unfortunately launched our new pricing model before it was even prepared, this was not done by us.

The price of $5.99 (4.99€) is only for Episode 1 and the remaining episodes will be available for $19.99 (16,79€). If you have bought the game for the lower price, you will only get Episode 1 but you can still upgrade to the full season. If you don't accept that pricing model, because of misinformation during that time, we'd encourage a refund.

Episode 2 and 3 will be released on April 12th, we will increase the price a couple of days prior to that. Buying episode 1 and the season pass (2-4) separately will cost $25.98. If you buy the bundle it will be at a reduced price. 

Note that if you have already purchased the game for the old price or will buy it before the next release, you will be unaffected by the increased price and will get all episodes.

The reason why we are doing this is because the scope of the game expanded rapidly. Our initial price decision was based on the plan of episodes that are around 1.5 hours long, but with more story and gameplay the episodes now stretch to around 4-5 hours. That's more than double the content. We also wanted to offer Episode 1 as a single purchase to offer players an entry to the game at a lower cost.


Your
Zein & Kevin

notes.title: Transmission #29: Double Release
notes.notes:
Hello there, hackers!

You've been probably wondering what we've been up to and how's the project going, right? Ususally, it's a good sign when you don't hear from us... it means we're deep in the development tunnel, which we were!

You've been waiting a long time and we need you to be patient a little bit longer, but... you'll get TWO NEW EPISODES in Q1 2019! 

The reason why it's taking so long is that the Episode 2: Memory and Episode 3: Backdoor are very intertwined, both in story and gameplay. There were many things that we shifted between episodes to make a better experience out of it. So by the time we entered testing phase for Ep 2, we already had so much stuff for Episode 3 done, that we decided it makes more sense to launch both of them together.

For us this makes also more sense from a financial standpoint, since we can record the voices in one go. 

That means we'll be delivering around 10 hours of play time by the time of March!

Gameplay (Ep. 2) 

Sneak around with Agent Bear and plot navigation routes past hostiles. Give him commands to start and stop in realtime and distract enemies with different methods to bring your partner safely to your destination.

https://media.giphy.com/media/fZYE9OIDoCgkcmwre1/giphy.gif


Help Raven infiltrate locations by finding information about personnel and files regarding their appearance to construct a disguise file and gain access to restricted areas.

https://media.giphy.com/media/dScZ10sfmZEvo1P4SF/giphy.gif

That's it for now! We hope you'll have wonderful holidays! Don't forget to join our Discord channel to stay updated about development: http://www.discord.gg/code7

Cheers,

Kevin & Zein

notes.title: Winter Update and Charity Sale
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29600143/7e511429c3d8e674c115df6211374e0322a71af8.jpg

Hi everyone,

we hope you're all doing well and are prepared for Christmas and the end of the year! We've been busy improving Episode 1 and adding features and are launching the big winter update, before logging off for the holidays.


German Version

We're happy to announce that with today's update the German translation is available. You can change the language in the main menu. Note, that the audio is still english, but all texts are now available in German.



 Accessible Version 

The accessible mode for blind and visually impaired players is now available and can be activated with CTRL + V. We hope you enjoy the game! We love to make games more accessible for everyone and are learning with every step. We're happy and thankful to have your support and feedback, it helped a lot!

On Steam, the update will download automatically. You'll have to re-download the DRM-free version. The update also includes a few minor tweaks and bug fixes. Also, the achievement Antibiotic is now possible to achieve as intended.


http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29600143/b6d9ac789456a68dea46da68d9cbf5044192c6ac.jpg
 
 
Charity Sale

To celebrate the accessible version, between Dec 13th and Dec 26th, we are donating 10% of Code 7's revenue to blista  . blista is a competence center for blind and visually-impaired people and at the same time an open and lively education and meeting site for all ages.

Help us share this event and create awareness for accessibility in gaming. Spread the hashtag #gamingwithoutbarriers!



Thank you all for your support and patience. Have a wonderful Christmas and a great start into the year!



Yours,
Kevin and Zein

notes.title: Patch #2
notes.notes:
Patch Notes (Version 1.2.0.2)

Thanks for keeping reporting issues and sending us feedback. Here are the recent changes.


 improved the usability of the ship puzzle in episode 0 and fixed a few bugs
 fixed an issue in which a save game was damaged when looking at your episode 0 decisions
 fixed an issue that made two of episode 1's achievements impossible (Matters of Security and Antibiotic)
 minor fixes and tweaks

notes.title: Patch #1
notes.notes:
Patch Notes (Version 1.2.0.1)

Hello, everyone! Thank you all who reported bugs and made it easier for us to fix them. For anyone who doesn't know where to report bugs, you can report them as tickets in our trello board: https://trello.com/b/FBNXZCCs/code-7-bugs
You have to comment on the card with the star to get added as a contributor.

Here are the changes:

Performance improvements in Network and Man-in-the-Middle Modes
Notes app now saves properly
The audio logs on Jenna's tablet are now accessible and not [NULL]
Fixed the issue where the Greenhouse dialogue would start from the beginning, although already completed
Fixed a bug where NPHINEAS would be accessible from other rooms
Fixed a bug where HKRAGER was accessible through network even though it was turned off physically
Fixed the issue where some passwords showed in cryptic symbols after hack
minor bugs fixes and some typos corrected

The current version number of the game is displayed in the bottom left corner of the settings screen.
